annotations.title: Add a clip with its sound

description: Puts another of their videos into the edit with its own sound: at the end, or at a film second (everything after moves later). Saved on its own. Saves a new version, all or nothing; restore_version undoes it. Cost: Free: no credits.

asset_id.description: A video asset_id from import_media or list_assets.

at.description: The film second it goes in (everything after moves later); the end when left out.

base_version.description: The version_id you read; refused if the video changed since. Left out: the live version, and a repeat is saved once.

from.description: The clip's first second to play.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

output_id.description: A Short, hook or shape of the video; the main video when left out.

to.description: The clip's last second to play.

name: add_clip

outputSchema.description: Clypmint add_clip result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Add a clip with its sound
